parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The maximum time range that can be queried is 24 hours (86,400 seconds). The query uses a left-closed, right-open interval. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS edge node.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type. Leave this parameter empty to query all types. Examples include vm, eip, single\_tenant, and nc.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 200.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description: The service type. For example: vm, eip, esk, or meta.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.
